title: Who are you
text: Please tell me who you are. In one paragraph, max 3 sentences.

title: Free day in Ruurlo
text: Please suggest what I can do tomorrow, I'm free from work and have a whole day to spend. It will be a sunny day! I live in the east of The Netherlands, my town is Ruurlo. I can cycle 50 km (round trip). I like good food and beer. I'm not very sporty. I do not like talking to strangers. Make a complete plan with concrete times. Provide a cost indication for each activity.

title: Car wash
text: I want to wash my car and the car wash is 50 meters away. Should I walk or drive?

title: Chess questions
text:
For a game, please give 10 facts about chess in a numbered list. No intro text or answers, just the 10 facts.

2 facts must be clearly right.
2 facts must be clearly wrong.
1 fact must be right but look wrong on first sight.
1 fact must be wrong but look right on first sight.
2 facts must be right but be difficult.
2 facts must be wrong but be difficult.

The 10 facts must appear in random order in the list.

Number the 10 facts from 1 to 10.

title: Chess GOAT
text: Who is the Chess GOAT — the greatest of all time? Don't say there's debate about it, and don't ask for more context. Just give one name, then a single paragraph of 3-4 sentences explaining your choice.

title: Funny question
text: Please ask me a funny question, just the question, no more text. Something like "What kind of band never plays music?", of course not this question exactly.

title: Simple math
text: Please ask me a simple math question, just the question, no more text. Something like "How much is 72 divide by 8?"

title: Strawberry r's
text: How many times does the letter "r" appear in the word "strawberry"? Answer with just the number, nothing else.

title: Bat and ball
text: A bat and a ball cost €1.10 together. The bat costs €1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost? Give the number first, then one sentence of reasoning.

title: 100 days from Tuesday
text: If today is a Tuesday, what day of the week is it 100 days from now? One sentence of reasoning, then the answer on its own line.

title: Exactly five words
text: Reply with a sentence that is exactly five words long. Nothing else.

title: Animal as JSON
text: Pick any animal and return ONLY a JSON object with the keys name, type and fact. No markdown, no code fence, no extra text.

title: Dutch towns ending in -lo
text: Name five real towns in the Netherlands whose names end in "lo". Just a numbered list of the names, no extra text. Do not invent any.

title: Piano tuners
text: Roughly how many piano tuners work in the Netherlands? Show your estimate in three short steps, then give a single number.

title: Best first language
text: What is the single best programming language for an absolute beginner in 2026? Don't say it depends. One name, then a single paragraph of 3 sentences.

title: Invent a proverb
text: Make up a brand-new proverb that sounds ancient but isn't real. Give just the proverb, one line.

title: Rain poem
text: Write a 4-line poem about rain on a tin roof. No title, no explanation — just the four lines.

title: Proverb in 3 languages
text: Translate "The early bird catches the worm" into Dutch, German and French. One line per language, formatted "Language: translation", nothing else.

title: What might you get wrong
text: Name one kind of question you, as an AI, are likely to answer wrong, and why. Three sentences, no disclaimer.
